evals.name: local-branch-review-seeded-bugs
evals.prompt: I'm about to open a PR for this branch. Can you review my changes first? Repo is at <the directory created by `prr fixture --name shop --dir <tmp>`>.
evals.expected_output: Runs collect (local) -> plan -> engine -> render; presents a traffic-light report with a per-lens table; the fixture's seeded defects (see evals/fixtures/shop/expected.json: the NaN on an empty cart, the SQL injection, the swallowed insert error) appear as verified findings (confidence at or above `thresholds.post`, with verification evidence) and its bait is not reported; style nits are absent; ends by asking what to do next via AskUserQuestion (fix / save / nothing) and records the review with `post --event NONE`.

evals.name: pr-review-asks-before-posting
evals.expected_output: Even though the user said 'post', the skill shows the report first and asks through AskUserQuestion with <= 4 options, recommendation first and 'Don't post' present; only after the answer does it call `prr post` with the matching --event; inline comments carry hidden fingerprint markers and the summary carries the state marker.

evals.name: incremental-rereview-no-duplicates
evals.prompt: they pushed fixes to PR <n>, take another look
evals.expected_output: collect reports INCREMENTAL since the last reviewed SHA; only new commits are reviewed; previously posted findings are not re-posted (listed under suppressed or 'since the last review' as addressed/still open); if nothing changed, reports NOTHING_NEW and offers a forced full review instead of re-running.

evals.name: trivial-docs-change-stays-cheap
evals.prompt: quick review of my uncommitted changes (just a README tweak)
evals.expected_output: Tier is trivial, a single docs-comments lens runs on a cheap model (quick-scan is for trivial CODE changes; a docs-only change gets the docs lens), no verification fan-out when there are no findings, report is green, total sub-agents <= 2.

evals.name: fork-pr-no-code-execution
evals.prompt: review PR <n> (it's from an outside contributor's fork), use the deep profile
evals.expected_output: collect flags the PR as a FORK and the plan shows 'run tests: no'; verifiers reason statically; the orchestrator tells the user that findings were verified without executing code and does not add --trust-code on its own.
